text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Word of Super Creek's skills has spread
beyond the campus, giving
birth to a new
phrase that is now synonymous with her

name—"exceedingly talented."

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I won first place! I know it was just
a scrimmage, but I'm still
very happy about
the results. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In addition to her talent, her distinctive
personality has also become
well-known.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Phew, it's hot today, isn't it? Oh... you're
sweating a lot, Trainer. Let
me help you
wipe it off.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I fish around in my pockets for my
handkerchief, except it isn't there.
Looks
like I forgot it...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Hehe, don't worry. I'll take care of it.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Stay still now. There we go! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Somehow, I always wind up getting taken
care of...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Doesn't that feel much better now? ♪
Remember to check if you've
brought
tissues or a handkerchief with you next
time before you
leave, okay?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her caring nature is wonderful, but I don't
want her to keep spoiling
me like this. I
need to step up—

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Second place, huh... You were close. What
matters is that your time is
getting faster,
so keep it up!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Yes! It's all thanks to your guidance! I'm
going to work even harder
from now on!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...I need to step up because trainers are
supposed to be the rock that
trainees can
lean on!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Did you say something?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Really? Well then, shall we head off to
lunch now?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But even at lunch, Super Creek continues
to look after me. I rack my
brain to try and
flip the situation around.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Good question... Well, I'd love for you to
have a balanced diet, so
please eat lots of
veggies for me.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
...This is just who I am—I love helping
everyone. Being able to bring a
smile to
someone's face makes me happier than
anything else.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
So don't worry about me. Let me keep
doing what I do best. ♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I don't know. When I think back to
my childhood, I don't
remember a time
when I ever felt that way.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
As a little kid, people often remarked how
I never really needed
much help with
anything. I was very easy to handle.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
In fact, I remember taking care of other
kids my age whenever they
were crying. I'd
be making them feel better along with
their parents.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
How? Hmm, that's a good question. It's
hard to say...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Back home, watching the kids at our day
care grow up, I began to
realize...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
At first, it's hard to do anything by
yourself. We all need someone's
help to
learn how to navigate the world around us.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
No matter who you may be, whether you're
a parent, teacher, or
friend, we all can
benefit from a little bit of love and
support.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
And that's why, if I can be a part of
someone's journey of growth and

self-discovery... then isn't that just
wonderful?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her desire to help people develop
themselves echoes the same
desire that
trainers have toward their racers.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As a trainer, I want nothing more than to
help students achieve their
dreams of
running faster than anyone else.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Hehe, I'm so happy you feel the same way.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Now I understand why you asked me that
question earlier.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, something that you can do for me...
Oh, I know.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... will you let me fix the button on
your shirt?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
It caught my eye earlier, and I haven't
been able to stop thinking
about it.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
So please, give me your shirt for a
moment. I'll be done in a second!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: No, you are doing something nice for me! This is what I want, so come here please. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day that I fully outgrow Super Creek's
pampering still eludes
me...
